question: How is the Great Lord approached in the second section?
premises: The second section presents the Great Lord as established as the self of all.
He is approached through gradual knowledge and yoga.
He is also approached through contemplations.
inference: In the second section the universal Lord is worshiped through graded contemplative and yogic means.
plain_english: Thus, in the second section, the Great Lord, established as the self of all, is worshiped through gradual knowledge and yoga and through contemplations.
